_doc: Registry of commands the e2e framework can drive. Each command maps to an engine driver (sourced .bash exposing e2e_run_<fn>), the tracking_kind its artifact uses, and the personas it runs against by default. run.sh discovers scenarios under scenarios/<command>/<feature>/ and dispatches each (scenario x persona) to the engine. persona_mode in a scenario ('scripted'|'live') selects how the human side is played; 'live' uses the two-real-model engine (live.bash) regardless of the command's default driver.
